title: MetaTwin-Guard: explainable and verifiable digital-twin assurance backend for a two-site cyber range (reference artifact, synthetic benchmark and field protocol)
description:
Reference software artifact (Supplementary File S3) for the article An Explainable and Verifiable Digital Twin of a Two-Site Cyber Range for Metaverse Infrastructure Assurance: Software Artifact and Field Protocol. It implements Ed25519 event verification (RFC 8032), SHA-256 payload and source hash chains (FIPS 180-4), replay/sequence checks, an admission-before-state twin invariant, static operational rules, a median/MAD robust explainable anomaly score, an integrity-aware hybrid decision and a 3-of-4 quorum-signed evidence chain (single-process emulation, not a distributed blockchain). Includes unit tests, a deterministic synthetic benchmark (seed 20260823, 6 scenarios x 8 runs, 17,280 events), executed ablation, sensitivity and multi-seed analyses, figures, a Google Colab notebook, the prospective field protocol (S1) and the blank field-data workbook (S2).

Evidence level B only: all results are synthetic software verification; no cyber-range field data are included. Test-fixture keys are deterministic and must never be used in a deployment.
